stats.armorType: Robe of the Archmagi, Staff of Power

additionalAbilities.name: Pact Magic
additionalAbilities.description: Kazuo has twelve 9th-level spell slots, regained after a Short Rest. Once per Long Rest, Eldritch Master restores all expended slots after 1 minute. Spell save DC 30; spell attack +24.

additionalAbilities.name: Spellcasting
additionalAbilities.description: Charisma is Kazuo's spellcasting ability. His Pact Magic slots are 9th level. Cantrips: Eldritch Blast, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation. Known: Armor of Agathys, Hex, Detect Thoughts, Counterspell, Dispel Magic, Fly, Sending, Banishment, Dimension Door, Scrying, Contact Other Plane, Hold Monster, Mass Suggestion, Finger of Death, Forcecage, Plane Shift, Power Word Stun, Demiplane, Blade of Disaster, Foresight, Globe of Invulnerability. Mystic Arcanum (once each without a slot): Arcane Gate, Etherealness, Dominate Monster, Power Word Kill. Signature Arcanum: Heal at 6th level and Wall of Force at 5th level, each once per Long Rest without a slot, or with an appropriate slot. Other free casts: Teleport once per Long Rest and also with slots; Rary's Telepathic Bond; Unseen Servant, Comprehend Languages, and Protection from Evil and Good at will; Misty Step and Dissonant Whispers once each per Long Rest. Find Familiar is a ritual.

additionalAbilities.name: Great Old One
additionalAbilities.description: Awakened Mind: telepathy 30 ft. Thought Shield: his thoughts cannot be read; he has Psychic resistance, and Psychic damage he takes is also dealt to the source. Create Thrall: he can touch an Incapacitated humanoid to charm it. Entropic Ward is described under Reactions.

additionalAbilities.name: Epic Boons
additionalAbilities.description: School Mastery: Conjuration (Unseen Servant, Teleport), Divination (Comprehend Languages, Rary's Telepathic Bond), Abjuration (Protection from Evil and Good, Heal), and Evocation (Wall of Force; Rote Casting spell not yet selected). Fortitude: +40 maximum HP, and healing received from spells or Hit Dice increases by 10. Fate: add 2d4 to a d20 roll made by Kazuo or a creature within 60 ft.; recharges when initiative is rolled. Skill: proficiency in all skills. Ability score increases are included in his scores.

additionalAbilities.name: Feats
additionalAbilities.description: Fey Touched, Resilient (Constitution), War Caster, and Alert. He has advantage on Constitution saves to maintain Concentration.

additionalAbilities.name: Eldritch Invocations
additionalAbilities.description: Agonizing Blast, Eldritch Spear, Devil's Sight, Armor of Shadows, One with Shadows, Ascendant Step, Mask of Many Faces, Master of Myriad Forms, Eyes of the Rune Keeper, Gaze of Two Minds, Voice of the Chain Master, and Investment of the Chain Master.

additionalAbilities.name: Attuned Items
additionalAbilities.description: Robe of the Archmagi, Rod of the Pact Keeper +3, and Staff of Power. The specified bonuses are already included in his statistics. He has advantage on saves against spells. The rod restores a spell slot once per day; the staff has 20 charges.

additionalAbilities.name: Gear
additionalAbilities.description: Sending Stones (Shuu holds the twin), Portable Hole, Bag of Holding, and three Potions of Supreme Healing. Six Manuals and Tomes have already been consumed and are reflected in his scores.

additionalAbilities.name: Crow Familiar
additionalAbilities.description: A raven familiar reflavored as a crow: Tiny; AC 12; HP 1 (1d4 − 1); Speed 10 ft., fly 50 ft.; STR 2, DEX 14, CON 8, INT 2, WIS 12, CHA 6; Perception +3, passive Perception 13. Beak: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1 Piercing damage. It can mimic simple sounds. Voice of the Chain Master and Investment of the Chain Master apply. It can warn Kazuo telepathically from any distance on the same plane when Shuu or a party member drops.

additionalAbilities.name: Rescue Teleport
additionalAbilities.description: Kazuo can use Teleport to reach Shuu, then on a later turn cast Teleport again to bring up to eight willing creatures to safety. Demiplane is a fallback shelter; Plane Shift can move the group to another plane.

actions.name: Wall of Force
actions.description: Action, range 120 ft.; Concentration, up to 10 minutes. Kazuo creates an invisible wall of force as a dome, globe, or contiguous panels. Nothing can physically pass through it, it is immune to damage, and Dispel Magic cannot dispel it; Disintegrate destroys it. It extends into the Ethereal Plane and blocks ethereal travel. Signature Arcanum: once per Long Rest without a slot, or using an appropriate spell slot.

reactions.name: Entropic Ward
reactions.description: Reaction: impose disadvantage on an attack against Kazuo. If it misses, Kazuo has advantage on his next attack against the attacker.

reactions.name: Counterspell
reactions.description: Reaction, range 60 ft., when a creature he can see casts a spell with Verbal, Somatic, or Material components. The caster makes a DC 30 Constitution saving throw. On failure its spell dissipates and the action is wasted; a spell slot used to cast it is not expended. Kazuo spends a 9th-level slot.
